title: Limits & usage
sub: Every number shows where it came from

plans.title: Plan windows
plans.none: No plan accounts yet. Codex accounts that sign in with ChatGPT, Gemini CLI accounts that sign in with Google, and coding-plan keys for Kimi Code, Z.ai, MiniMax and OpenCode Go show their windows here.
plans.noSamples: No runner has reported usage yet, so every window stays Unknown instead of a guessed percentage.
plans.claudeNote: Claude Code runs on API keys only, so it has no plan window; its spend counts against the caps on the right.

state.no_plan: No coding plan on this key: it is billed pay as you go.
state.error: Last quota check failed: {{problem}}. Its windows show Unknown until a check succeeds.

plans.noProfile: Readings are kept per profile; add a profile that uses this key to see its windows.

spend.title: API spend · {{range}}
spend.empty: No API spend recorded in this range.

caps.title: Balances and caps
caps.empty: No API keys yet. Add one from Providers.
caps.meter: {{name}}: {{pct}} percent of the daily cap used
caps.invalid: Use an amount of zero or more, or leave it empty for no cap.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.hint: Applies to plan windows and daily caps.
alerts.invalid: Use whole percentages, with notify below critical.
alerts.idleHint: About every {{minutes}} minutes, spread a little, and only for signed-in Codex profiles a task uses; twice as often while a window is rising. Runs report their own windows.
alerts.planQuotaHint: Off by default: the providers do not document these endpoints. When on, the same pacing applies, only for keys a task uses. A response we do not recognise shows Unknown, never 0%.
